replies.author: @Trevslife
replies.text:
@MindfulTravelUS been going there for 15 years in the dive business . It’s too far from Luzon for the Yanks and no red light district and too Liberal politically . Too independent of the corruption that exists in Papanga and Manila and less convenient for Stateside Air Travel . The expat community in PP are a diverse lot of Europeans South Africans and keep it very low key . They will not include Americans and are quite abrasive towards them as are the local Filipina . 
PP is the hub for Tubbataha and so attracts a world wide interest . So Americans are outnumbered and so they are not comfortable and tend to gravitate to their traditional enclaves of Subic Angeles & Manila where they are generationally more familiar .

replies.text: We appreciate your feedback and would love to hear more about your perspective on the expat community demographics in Puerto Princesa.
